assumptions: The paper assumes readers know LLM agents, SWE-bench, WebArena, CodeAct, BrowserGym, Docker, REST APIs, IPython, Playwright, accessibility trees, pass@k, zero-shot and 1-shot prompting; adjacent ML readers may not know these subfield terms.
The paper uses many system names (CodeActAgent, BrowsingAgent, GPTSwarm, AgentSkills, AgentHub, micro agents) with brief definitions.
Benchmarks are named without explaining metrics; "success rate" and "resolve rate" are used interchangeably across tables.
